### Reconciliation and disposition

- The 2023 project record is not purely favorable: Rooppur advanced to fuel delivery, but supporting transmission and physical-protection infrastructure faced schedule risk. The Daily Star reports that test production depended on unfinished evacuation infrastructure. [The Daily Star](https://www.thedailystar.net/business/economy/news/rooppur-will-be-ready-time-3398991)
- BAEC documentation provides concrete evidence of pre-operational radiation monitoring, fuel-license review, and readiness activity, but remains institutionally interested rather than independent. [BAEC Annual Report PDF](https://objectstorage.ap-dcc-gazipur-1.oraclecloud15.com/n/axvjbnqprylg/b/V2Ministry/o/office-baec/2024/12/d82f0646b9a14bb1868a8ac6d0643207.pdf)
- The IAEA conference contribution supports a narrower finding that radioactive-waste planning was an identified implementation challenge in 2023. [IAEA conference record](https://conferences.iaea.org/event/330/contributions/28866/)
- AP’s contemporaneous report confirms the plant remained under construction when fuel arrived, with first-unit operation projected for July 2024 rather than 2023; it also records official assurances on spent fuel and natural-disaster safety. [AP](https://apnews.com/article/bangladesh-russia-nuclear-plant-b38f3dcdce3404c3da0be1d68e7ba469)
- I found no independent 2023 accident, near-miss, safeguards violation, or emergency-drill failure. That absence remains an evidence limitation, not affirmative evidence of safety.
